sources.title: Bjarke Ingels: The Alchemist
sources.quote_checked: we are much more interested in evolution than revolution | The architect is more like a midwife for the permanent rebirth of a city and less like her creator | The uniqueness and the performance become one and the same | In our case the buildings are actually creating nature

sources.title: Bjarke Ingels: Architect Interview 2024 (King Toronto)
sources.quote_checked: within the constraints and confines of the canvas you have to play with | you try to make the best possible manifestation of the ideal world | the fundamental agenda is to reconcile what seems at the surface to be polarized opposites

sources.title: Bjarke Ingels and Amy Astley in Conversation at the Guggenheim New York
